# Vita 1.3.9
- Expands custom parametric EQ presets to 32 bands. - Supports up to 10 custom EQ presets with bounded scrolling for long lists. - Organizes settings into Audio, Processing, and General tabs. - Adds adjustable headphone crossfeed with a 0–2 ms interaural delay. - Fixes a crash when the output device or sample rate changes while crossfeed is active.

# Vita 1.3.7
- Completes the `net.sidelabs.Vita` bundle identifier migration after the verified 1.3.6 bridge update. - Preserves the bug report disclosure and strengthened Sparkle verification. - Uses the Vita app icon for the mounted installer volume.

# Vita 1.3.6
- Migrates Vita to the `net.sidelabs.Vita` bundle identifier while preserving existing settings and custom EQ presets. - Adds a compact disclosure showing the basic information included with bug reports. - Requires signed Sparkle feeds and verifies updates before extraction. - Marks this build as the public update-path test release.

# Vita 1.3.5
- Vita now runs its EQ path when SPL Vitalizer is not installed. - Added an independent Vitalizer switch in Settings. The main Enabled switch continues to control the complete audio route. - Added the Vita name and version to the Settings footer. - Custom parametric EQ presets now support up to 12 bands, including TXT import and export. - Reconfigured the Vitalizer Audio Unit when the output sample rate changes. - Removed a realtime lock wait from the EQ render callback and hardened imported filter values. - Added Launch at Login and an in-app bug report form with optional bounded diagnostics. - Configured the production Sparkle feed and signing public key.
